notes.title: Aqua Populo out now!
notes.content:
Aqua Populo Version 1 is here, join the Leaderboard and test your skill!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42242401/3cc75dacfdf3145052b1b6d57d8b5899a8eb3b26.gif

How deep can you go?
Pilot your sub through 100 waves of angry sea-life and punishing bosses in Normal Mode or see how long you can survive the mounting pressure of Timer Mode.

Normal Mode:
You will descend through 100 challenging waves facing 10 punishing bosses as you progress through Normal Mode. Enemy spawn points and bonuses are randomized on every run. Complete Normal Mode to unlock Survival difficulty with no 1-Up bonuses from standard enemies and dedicated leaderboards.
Timer Mode:
In Timer Mode the waves are endless with bosses triggered by timer rather than wave count. The boss encounter rate and HP increases as you descend. Try your luck and see how long you can survive... 

Features:
 Normal Mode
 Timer Mode
 10 Bonuses
 10 Bosses
 4 Difficulties
 4 Leaderboards
 30 Achievements
 13 Languages
 Keyboard or Controller
